title: termal_review_freeze_check fails with HTTP 500 (os error 2) while target/release/termal.exe is being replaced by an install
outcome: The host's freeze checker doesn't depend on the installed binary at target/release/termal.exe being present and unchanged. Replacing that file (rename aside, copy new) while the host runs never makes a reviewer's freeze check fail, or the failure is a typed, retryable refusal naming the cause.
acceptance: Diagnose, with source locators, how the checker resolves its executable (review_freeze_api.rs uses std::env::current_exe() at ~106) and confirm or refute that an install's rename-then-copy window explains HTTP 500 "review checker did not complete: The system cannot find the file specified. (os error 2)".

If confirmed: the checker runs from an executable path that an install can't remove from under it (e.g. resolved and opened once at host start), or the install procedure documents a way that leaves no window; a test or documented drill shows a check during a replace succeeds or refuses with a typed, retryable reason.
